authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Boardwalk and firm viewing pad are navigable; water and soft-sand regions are excluded from accessible route. Exposed boardwalk edges have guards or movement bounds. Target bounding dimensions 32m wide x 0.3m high x 26m deep. Materials: sand-muted. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
